user-agreement.title: User Agreement
user-agreement.content:
Welcome to the KARMASRI Portal, an initiative of the General Administration(AIS) Department (GAD), Government of Kerala. By accessing or using this portal, you acknowledge and agree to abide by the following Terms and Conditions.

1. Eligibility

The KARMASRI Portal is intended for use by All India Services (AIS) Kerala Cadre officers, including officers belonging to the Indian Administrative Service (IAS), Indian Police Service (IPS), and Indian Forest Service (IFS).

2. Registration and Account Security

To access specific services and functionalities of the KARMASRI Portal, users may be required to register and create an account. Users are responsible for:

  • Safeguarding the confidentiality of their login credentials and account information;
  • All actions and activities performed through their account;
  • Ensuring that all information provided during registration and subsequent usage is accurate, complete, and up to date.

The KARMASRI Portal reserves the right to suspend, restrict, or terminate any account found to contain false, inaccurate, misleading, or unauthorized information.

3. Authentication and Login Access

The KARMASRI Portal provides secure login and authentication mechanisms for authorized users. Users are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of their login credentials and for all activities carried out through their accounts. By accessing the portal, users consent to the collection and use of basic authentication-related information required for identity verification, access management, and service delivery, in accordance with applicable policies and security standards.

4. User Content and Acceptable Use

Users are solely responsible for any information, documents, records, or data uploaded, submitted, or shared through the KARMASRI Portal.

By using the portal, users agree that:

  • All information and documents submitted are genuine, accurate, and legally valid;
  • They possess the necessary authorization, rights, and permissions for the submitted content;
  • They shall not engage in any unlawful, fraudulent, abusive, defamatory, or malicious activities through the portal;
  • They shall not attempt to interfere with, compromise, disrupt, or misuse the portal, its services, or associated systems.

The Government of Kerala reserves the right to restrict access, suspend accounts, or remove any content found to violate these Terms and Conditions or applicable laws and regulations.

5. Data Privacy and Security

The KARMASRI Portal implements appropriate technical and administrative measures to safeguard user information from unauthorized access, misuse, disclosure, modification, or loss.

However, users acknowledge and understand that:

  • No electronic platform, network, or method of data transmission can be guaranteed to be completely secure;
  • The portal may occasionally experience interruptions, delays, or technical issues beyond administrative control.

The portal may also include links, integrations, or references to third-party websites or external services. The Government of Kerala shall not be held responsible for the privacy practices, security policies, or content of such external platforms or services.

6. Intellectual Property Rights

All content, software, logos, design components, documents, trademarks, and other intellectual property associated with the KARMASRI Portal are the property of, or are duly licensed to, the Government of Kerala. Users are granted a limited, non-exclusive, non-transferable, and revocable permission to access and use the portal solely for lawful and officially authorized purposes. Any unauthorized copying, reproduction, alteration, distribution, publication, or commercial use of the portal content or materials is strictly prohibited.

7. Termination or Suspension of Access

The KARMASRI Portal administration reserves the right to suspend, restrict, or terminate user access, either temporarily or permanently, without prior notice, under circumstances including but not limited to:

  • Violation of the Terms and Conditions of the portal;
  • Submission of false, inaccurate, or fraudulent information;
  • Misuse of portal services or activities posing security risks;
  • Compliance with applicable legal, administrative, or regulatory requirements.

8. Disclaimer of Warranties

The KARMASRI Portal and all related services are provided on an “as is” and “as available” basis, without any express or implied warranties of any kind.

The Government of Kerala does not warrant or guarantee that:

  • The portal will operate continuously, securely, or without interruptions or errors;
  • Any defects, issues, or technical problems will be resolved immediately;
  • The portal or its servers will remain completely free from viruses, malware, or other harmful components.

9. Limitation of Liability

To the fullest extent permitted under applicable laws, the Government of Kerala, its departments, officials, employees, representatives, and associated entities shall not be held liable for any indirect, incidental, consequential, special, or punitive damages arising out of or in connection with:

  • The use of, or inability to access or use, the KARMASRI Portal;
  • Unauthorized access to, or alteration of, user information or data;
  • Service disruptions, system downtime, or technical malfunctions;
  • Dependence on or use of the information, content, or services provided through the portal.

10. Modifications to the Agreement

The KARMASRI Portal administration reserves the right to revise, amend, or update this User Agreement at any time without prior notice. Any changes made to this Agreement shall take effect immediately upon being published on the KARMASRI Portal. Continued access to or use of the portal after such modifications shall be considered as acceptance of the updated Terms and Conditions.

11. Governing Law and Jurisdiction

This Agreement shall be governed by and interpreted in accordance with the laws applicable in the State of Kerala and the Republic of India. Any disputes arising in connection with this Agreement shall fall under the jurisdiction of the competent courts in Kerala.

12. Contact Information

For any queries, support requests, or concerns regarding this User Agreement or the KARMASRI Portal, please contact:

privacy-policy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy-policy.content:
1. Personal Data Collection and Usage

The KARMASRI Portal collects and processes personal information required for the effective management of Kerala Cadre All India Services (AIS) Officers and related administrative services. The information collected may include personal identification details, demographic information, official and professional records, cadre and posting details, educational qualifications, training details, awards, disability details, disciplinary records, employment information, and family or dependent details wherever applicable.

Such information may be collected during Executive Record Profile enrichment, profile updates, service requests, document submissions, or while using the KARMASRI Portal and its associated services. The collected data is used strictly for official administrative purposes including user authentication, account management, service delivery, cadre and resource management, workflow processing, communication, reporting, audit, system improvement, and other functions permitted under applicable Government policies and regulations.

2. Electronic Verification Code (EVC) Authentication

The KARMASRI Portal uses Electronic Verification Code (EVC)–based verification to authenticate users and validate consent for specific actions, submissions, and approvals within the portal. As part of the EVC process, the portal may collect limited information such as registered mobile number or email address, OTP or verification details, user login information, and related audit records including date and time of verification.

This information is used solely for secure authentication, consent validation, transaction processing, security monitoring, and audit purposes. Appropriate security measures are implemented to protect EVC-related information from unauthorized access or misuse. By using EVC verification within the portal, users consent to the collection and use of such information for authorized service-related activities.

cookie-policy.title: Cookie Policy
cookie-policy.content:
The KARMASRI Portal uses cookies to enhance your browsing experience, maintain session security, and analyze portal traffic. By using our portal, you consent to the use of these cookies in accordance with this policy.

What are Cookies? Cookies are small text files placed on your device by websites you visit. They are widely used to make websites work more efficiently and to provide information to the owners of the site.

How We Use Cookies: We primarily use strictly necessary cookies to ensure the core functionalities of the portal, such as user authentication and secure session management. We may also use analytical cookies to understand how users interact with the portal, which helps us improve its design and functionality.

Managing Cookies: Most web browsers allow you to control cookies through their settings. You can choose to block or delete cookies; however, please note that disabling cookies may affect the functionality and your ability to use certain features of the KARMASRI Portal.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.content:
The KARMASRI Portal is a service-oriented digital initiative of the General Administration(AIS) Department (GAD), Government of Kerala, designed and developed by Centre for Digital Innovation and Product Development (CDIPD), Digital University Kerala.

This portal has been developed as a centralized digital platform for Kerala Cadre All India Services (AIS) Officers, including officers of the Indian Administrative Service (IAS), Indian Police Service (IPS), and Indian Forest Service (IFS), with the objective of enabling efficient Resource Management and Service-Related Administration.

The KARMASRI Portal facilitates streamlined access to officer-related information, administrative services, resource management functions, and other official workflows under the General Administration(AIS) Department (GAD), Government of Kerala.

The General Administration (AIS) Department (GAD), Government of Kerala, manages and maintains the content and services of the KARMASRI Portal. We welcome suggestions for improving the portal and request users to kindly report any discrepancies or errors noticed during usage.
